messages:
Emma - Support: Heads-up — we got an escalated ticket from Acme. They hit a reproducible bug when making parallel tool calls (search + summarize) via the /v1/assist API. The tool_result items are being associated to the wrong tool in responses (tool_result.id doesn't match input call id). Repro + logs below.

Noah - Support: Customer says it started after last week's runtime deploy. They see it ~3x out of 10 runs, more often under higher concurrency. Latency spikes also reported.

Emma - Support: Repro steps we used: 1) POST /v1/assist with tools:[{id: "search", ...}, {id: "summarize", ...}] and requests split into two parallel tool invocations by the agent. 2) search finishes slowly or fast, summarize can finish before search. 3) Response contains tool_result array where the result bodies are correct but the tool id mapping is swapped. Payload we sent: 

```json
{
  "model": "redwood-1-small",
  "input": "Find docs for billing edge-case",
  "tools": [
    {"id": "search", "name": "internal_search", "schema": {"q": "string"}},
    {"id": "summarize", "name": "abstractive_summarizer", "schema": {"text": "string"}}
  ]
}
```

And the returned snippet: 

```json
{
  "tool_result": [
    {"id": "search", "output": "Summary text from summarizer..."},
    {"id": "summarize", "output": {"hits": [{"title":"..."}]}}
  ]
}
```

Emma - Support: Note how the outputs are correct bodies but assigned to the wrong id. Error logs from the runtime: 

`ERROR runtime: tool_result_association: request_id=rq_abc123 correlation=ci_778 mismatch on tool_id mapping sequence (expected order mapping vs completion-order)`

Mike - Eng Runtime: tagging in. Thanks Emma. Can you paste the full request/response headers and the request_id? Also which sdk/version and whether using streaming?

Emma - Support: request_id=rq_abc123, sdk-js v2.19.1, using non-streaming assist. Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <redacted>`, `X-Request-Client: acme-web-v1`. Full body above. We reproduced locally with a small script that fires the two tool tasks concurrently to simulate different completion orders.

Sophia - Eng ML: This sounds like an ordering/race mapping bug where we index results by array position rather than tool.id. We recently merged a change to the agent orchestration to parallelize tool execution. Might be related. Can you confirm if tools have client-provided id stable across calls?

Emma - Support: Yes, customer uses explicit ids (search / summarize). They are stable. When we swap ids in response, the tool returned bodies still match their own schema (e.g., summarizer body matches summarizer schema) but id labels are swapped. So association mapping logic is wrong.

Mike - Eng Runtime: I pulled the runtime logs and see this stack: `agent.dispatcher -> parallel_worker -> collectResults -> assemble_tool_result`. collectResults currently appends results in completion order and then zips with requested_tools by index. That's bad. Immediate mitigation: I'll change assemble to map by tool_call_id if present, else fallback.

Noah - Support: Customer is asking for a workaround until patch rolls. They can serialize tool calls (no parallel) but that's a perf hit. Anything else?

Mike - Eng Runtime: Short term patch rolling now: if result.tool_id present we remap on apply. I will push hotfix to canary region and roll to prod after validation. ETA ~2h. Will update here once canary passes.

deploy-bot: Deployed canary build runtime@2026.03.17-hotfix-1 to region us-west-2.

Liam - Customer Success: I told the customer we've identified root cause (mapping-by-index bug) and we have a canary patch up. Offering to enable a temporary per-customer serialization flag or reduce concurrency for their workload until fully rolled. They're happy to accept the flag.

Sophia - Eng ML: We should add a regression test: parallel tool execution with randomized completion order asserting tool_result mapping by id. I'll own a unit test for the agent orchestrator.

Mike - Eng Runtime: Agreed. Also adding a small e2e that runs the SDK repro harness. After canary: run 100 randomized trials, expect 0 mismatches.

Emma - Support: Customer confirmed can we enable the serialization flag now. If Mike needs the customer id, it's acme-corp (acct 987654).

Mike - Eng Runtime: Enabled per-account serialization toggle for acct 987654 as temporary mitigation. Can you confirm with customer?

Noah - Support: Confirmed with customer — they ran their workflow 20 times and no mismatches so far. Latency is higher but acceptable for short term.

Emma - Support: Follow-ups: (1) Mike to monitor canary metrics (tool_result_mismatch count) and upload a short postmortem once fixed; (2) Sophia to add unit/regression tests; (3) Support/CS to continue customer comms and consider credit for impacted runs if we find it hit them in prod heavily.

Mike - Eng Runtime: I'll follow up with metrics + PR link. Preliminary root cause: indexing by completion-order instead of tool.id when assembling parallel results. Will open PR to fix collectResults mapping and add tests.

Sophia - Eng ML: Also double-check schema validation path — ensure we don't silently coerce or reorder payloads when schema validation fails for one tool. If one tool fails schema, we must still return proper tool_result with error and correct id.

Emma - Support: Noted. I'll keep the thread updated. Thanks all :thumbsup:
